(2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a nervous animated boy in a red shirt, sweating profusely with wide, anxious eyes. (3) A digital interface appears showing four boxes labeled A, B, C, and D, each containing a different cat tail silhouette. (4) The host reappears, pointing at the camera as option A is digitally removed from the selection grid. (5) The boy contestant is shown again, looking intensely stressed while a countdown timer pulses in the background with vibrant colors. (6) The boy suddenly looks determined and shouts the answer 'C', followed by a large pink letter C graphic appearing on screen with sparkles. (7) An animated version of the boy in a tuxedo and glasses appears next to the '明星3缺1' game logo. (8) A screen recording of the mobile game '明星3缺1' shows a character selection menu featuring Lan Lan Cat. (9) The shot transitions to a real-world view of human hands holding a foldable smartphone displaying the mahjong game interface, then returns to the smart boy animation for a final sign-off.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration with an enthusiastic game show host tone begins over a fast, rhythmic electronic BGM. Digital 'bloop' sounds accompany UI transitions. (2) A second male voice, sounding younger and highly distressed, enters with loud shouting and audible vocal strain, representing the panicked contestant. (3) The host initiates a countdown where sharp 'ding' sound effects trigger on each beat (3, 2, 1) over a swelling synth riser. (4) A loud percussive 'impact' SFX sounds as the contestant yells his answer, transitioning into a triumphant, major-key musical jingle. (5) The final phase features a confident, professional narrative voice explaining the game's features, layered with crisp mahjong tile clacking SFX and high-fidelity digital interface sounds.
